correctness.rationale: With A=37/25+C/4, the first critical image runs from 321/400 to 371/400. The right branch gives the second image (15−8A)(72A+1)/1024, positive and at most 1.98(1−321/400)<1/2, so the third iterate uses the left branch for the entire range. Independent integer polynomial multiplication gave third-iterate-minus-one-half numerator coefficients (−2096927,93600,5522816,−3594240,331776), ascending in A at denominator 4194304, agreeing with the stated factorization. Only the increasing quadratic factor changes sign in the range. Its admissible root gives the stated C and ℓ<h with ℓ<1/2<h, so the least period is three. The endpoints 0,ℓ,1/2,h,1 map to 0,1/2,h,ℓ,0, proving the four transitions by branch monotonicity. Both branch slopes have magnitude at least A>1; cylinders shrink and the expanding Markov entropy formula gives log ρ(M)=log φ, since the other components have radii at most one. On [ℓ,h] the core transition matrix is primitive, so cylinders inside any open subinterval eventually cover both cells for all sufficiently large iterate times. Points above h enter (0,ℓ); a positive point remaining below ℓ would increase to a positive fixed point there, impossible, and when it crosses ℓ it cannot overshoot 1/2. Only the two endpoints fall to 0 without entering the core. The supplied symbolic checker was read, not run; the proof, not a finite orbit sample, supports expansion, mixing and finite absorption.
